explanation_full: The GREY RELATIONAL ANALYSIS (GRA) feature ranking demonstrates that Sucrose_Degradation is the most critical feature, scoring 0.9998. VFA is the second most important feature (0.9994), and COD-O is the third most important feature (0.9990). These top three features are highly correlated with the target variable. Furthermore, the model performance section shows that the Decision Tree (DT) model achieved an R² of 1.00000, confirming the strong predictive capability of the selected features.
